seo.title: Kitchen sink
seo.description: Every part of the default theme in the context of a page: the edge cases a real site runs into sooner or later.

values.heading: Kitchen sink
values.body:
The pages under this one show the default theme at its edges: long words, dark blocks in the main column, blocks side by side on a narrow screen.
They come with the demo and go with php artisan webx:demo --remove — a real site never has them.

seo.title: Long words
seo.description: Words longer than a phone is wide, in the languages that have them.

values.heading: Donaudampfschifffahrtsgesellschaftskapitänsmützenabzeichen
values.body: German glues nouns together: Rindfleischetikettierungsüberwachungsaufgabenübertragungsgesetz was a real law, and a heading like the one above has to break inside the word rather than push the page sideways.

values.heading: Konstantynopolitańczykowianeczka
values.body: Polish brings its own letters and its own lengths: najprawdopodobniej, dziewięćdziesięciokilkuletni, współpracowniczka. Ąą Ćć Ęę Łł Ńń Óó Śś Źź Żż — every one of them in the font the theme names.

values.heading: Превысокомногорассмотрительствующий
values.body:
Cyrillic, which a site with Russian among its languages prints on every page: человеконенавистничество, высокопревосходительство.
An address with no place to break: https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/goes/on/and/on/without/a/single/space/in/it/anywhere

seo.title: Blocks in the column
seo.description: A dark block, text and columns one after another in the main column of the page.

values.title: A dark block in the main column
values.subtitle: The prose of the theme reaches every block inside the page, so its colours must not assume a light background: this heading and this line stay readable on navy.

values.heading: Text right after it
values.body: The column and the blocks share one left edge, and nothing on this page scrolls sideways at 360 pixels.

values.heading: One
values.body: Three columns on a wide screen, one under another on a phone.

values.heading: Two
values.body: A column with a longer text in it, so that the three are not the same height and the grid has to say what it does about that.

seo.title: Header and menu
seo.description: The header of the theme at every width: dropdowns, the mobile menu, a sticky bar and anchors under it.

values.heading: The header and the mobile menu
values.body:
Every page has the header of the theme, so this one is about trying it. Hover the items with an arrow: a dropdown opens after a short delay and stays while the pointer goes to it. On a phone the first tap opens it and the second follows the link. From the keyboard Enter or Space opens a dropdown, the arrows move inside, Esc closes it.
Make the window narrower: the items fold into the menu exactly when they no longer fit in a row, not at a fixed width.

values.heading: The mobile menu
values.body: It opens from the right with the logo on top and the call to action at the bottom. The page under it does not scroll; its own body does. Back in the browser closes it instead of leaving the page, and so does a swipe to the right. A branch of the menu opens over its parent, with Back and the branch name on top; the branch of the page you are on is open already.

values.heading: A sticky header and anchors
values.body: The header stays on top while the page scrolls. A link to a heading further down stops below the header rather than under it: the header keeps its height in --webx-header-height and the page scrolls by it.

values.heading: A long page to scroll
values.body:
This text is here so that the page is longer than a phone. Scroll down and up again and watch the header stay.
Lorem ipsum is not used on purpose: a showcase in words reads as a page, and a page is what the header lives on.
The next pages go two levels deeper, which is where the mobile menu needs Back.

seo.title: Second level
seo.description: A page one level below the header showcase, with a page under it in turn.

values.heading: Second level
values.body: In the header this page is an entry of the dropdown under Kitchen sink › Header and menu. In the mobile menu it is a branch of its own.

seo.title: Third level
seo.description: Three levels down: the mobile menu opens on this branch with Back to each level above.

values.heading: Third level
values.body: Open the mobile menu here: it starts on this branch, the page marked as current, and Back goes up one level at a time.
